description: This file defines API routes related to managing trip budgets and expenses within a Travel Planner application. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating/updating, and deleting budgets and expenses, along with internal helper functions for data transformation.

classes.name: BudgetResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a trip's budget and associated expenses.

methods.name: ExpenseResponse _expense_to_response(exp: Expense)
methods.description: Converts an Expense ORM object to an ExpenseResponse schema.

methods.name: BudgetResponse _budget_to_response(budget: Budget)
methods.description: Converts a Budget ORM object to a BudgetResponse schema.

methods.name: get_budget( trip_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves the budget and expenses for a specified trip, returning an empty budget if none exists.

methods.name: upsert_budget( trip_id: str, payload: BudgetPayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates or updates a trip budget (upsert operation).

methods.name: create_expense( trip_id: str, payload: ExpensePayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Adds a new expense to a trip, automatically creating a budget if necessary.

methods.name: delete_expense( trip_id: str, expense_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes a specific expense from a trip's budget.

ctags.signature: ( trip_id: str, payload: ExpensePayload, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.signature: ( trip_id: str, expense_id: str, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
